provenance.method: Bounded review of National Autistic Society eating guidance; charity guidance is kept separate from clinical authority.

name: National Autistic Society eating guide
description: Autism-specific practical guide discussing sensory experience, eating environment, restricted food range and indicators for seeking further advice.
intended_use: Generating practical questions about sensory and environmental barriers around food without treating autistic eating patterns as one uniform problem.
audience_or_context: Autistic people, families and supporters; practical autism guidance rather than a diagnostic or dietetic service.
limitations: The guide cannot diagnose ARFID, nutritional deficiency or another medical condition.
Its review date is older than the NHS clinical overview, so clinical escalation decisions should use current health-service guidance.
